decision_verbatim: vamos desligar imediatamente, e ligar o backend tambem, sem snapshot estagnado. Sua missao e entregar o modelo de producao ligado imediatamente, sem considerar fases irrealistas de cutover, pois lembrando: nao temos nenhum modelo atualmente, e este sera o primeiro que produz resultados reais e confiaveis, sem isso o sistema todo e imprestavel.
decision: FULL IMMEDIATE ACTIVATION. The incumbent producer is switched off immediately; the backend consumer is switched to the new open_macro_v03 tables immediately (no stagnant snapshot, no phased cutover, no as-if window separating publication from consumption). The activation PR delivers: new tables + daily worker + feature flag + governance flip + backend cutover + incumbent switch-off, as ONE coordinated change. The published decision and allocation are REAL, CONSUMED, OFFICIAL output from day one.
rationale_recorded: There is no trustworthy model in production today; the phased cutover was designed to protect a consumer of data the owner deems worthless - protecting it protects nothing. The first reliable model IS the product the system exists for; without it the whole system is unusable.
observation_window_effect: The 10-business-day window becomes INTENSIVE SUPERVISION OVER LIVE PRODUCTION (daily independent re-compute verifier, live SLO/staleness/missing-output alerts, kill switch armed), not an as-if staging period. official_result is true from activation; a window abort fires the kill switch and invalidates traceably, returning the system to its prior state (no reliable model - explicitly accepted by the owner as the status quo).
supersedes_in_this_plan: the two-step decommission proposal and the write-only as-if consumption mode of Stage B/C
